description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moratumulla, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520202
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with the amendment of land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It specifies corrections to land parcel extents (area measurements) for specific properties in Colombo District, including detailed location descriptions (cadastral map numbers, village names, Grama Niladhari divisions). The content is purely land/property-related, falling squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land administrative matters.
